name: amazon_dsp-mcp
description: Amazon DSP (ads): me, list_accounts. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_DSP_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_client_id.description: Login with Amazon client id of the app approved for the Amazon Ads API; also sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId header.

platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_DSP_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_client_secret.description: The LWA client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_DSP_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_refresh_token.description: LWA refresh token from the advertiser's consent (scope advertising::campaign_management); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token.

platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_api_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_DSP_API_HOST
platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_api_host.description: Regional Amazon Ads API host: advertising-api.amazon.com (North America), advertising-api-eu.amazon.com (Europe) or advertising-api-fe.amazon.com (Far East).

platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_profile_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_DSP_PROFILE_ID
platform_mcp_amazon_dsp_profile_id.description: Advertising profile id of the DSP entity (from GET /v2/profiles; accountInfo.type must be `agency`), sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/profiles/{profileId}: the configured profile {profileId, countryCode, currencyCode, timezone, accountInfo {id, type, name, marketplaceStringId}}.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /dsp/advertisers (startIndex/count, max 100): DSP advertisers of the configured DSP entity profile ({advertiserId, name, currency, url, country, timezone}).
